data.narrative:
General Galactic, a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Halen Mattison and Luke Neise, has raised $10M to date. The comparable universe in Climate & Energy includes one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median approach—zero datapoints met the narrow filtering criteria—making stage-progression the primary applicable method.

Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 2.5x multiplier to the $10M raised proxy, reflecting expected value creation from seed to subsequent stage. This yields an implied valuation of $25M. Given the single-method nature of this analysis, a modest range around this point estimate accounts for execution and market timing risk.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $21M (low) to $29M (high), with a median of $25M. Key uncertainties include the availability of sufficient climate-tech seed comparables for validation and the company's path to later-stage funding. The analysis would benefit from expansion of the peer set or availability of transaction data from the Climate & Energy sector at comparable stages.
